# clavis identities

<p class="cli-lead">Manage machine and workload identities</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis identities <command>
```

</div>

Identities are non-human users: CI pipelines, servers, Kubernetes
workloads and AI agents. They get a token, or exchange a workload OIDC
token (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP) for a short-lived
one, so no long-lived secret sits in CI.
